newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Vietnam tender to sell Dai Hung crude closes.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam tender to sell Dai Hung crude closes.

text.p: The consortium operating the Vietnamese Dai Hung crude field has issued a tender to sell a 450,000 barrel cargo, for loading at the end of June or early July, traders said on Wednesday.
The tender closed earlier Wednesday and an award was expected by Thursday.
The last sell tender awarded a June cargo to Japan's Sumitomo Corp, at Minas APPI +20/30 cents per barrel.

The equity producers of the Dai Hung field are Malaysia's state-owned Petronas, with 20 percent, Japan's Sumitomo with 10.625 percent, France's Total SA with 10.625 percent and state-owned Petrovietnam, with 15 percent.
Petronas is in the process of buying out the 43.75 percent stake of Australia's Broken Hill Pty Co. Ltd.
